events.title: Next Fest Update - Demo to 0.9.5
events.summary: New levels, mechanics and music but also numerous quality improvements and brand new localization support for 19 languages. Some highlights: Explore the new Sauna level one of the first levels in the game Set the new difficulty settings to one of thee levels Race the clock to earn medals on each levelPATCH NOTES (0.9.5)LevelsNew level: SaunaImplemented more dynamic audioMechanicsNew difficulty optionsNew medal rewardsAuto swap empty weaponEnemiesNew shotgun enemyImproved animation behaviorWeapon

events.title: Demo Update to 0.8.7
events.summary: PATCH NOTES (0.8.7)Alright you Meat sacks,We are updating the demo to version 0.8.7. While most of the work on Tremen is going into the production of new levels for the final release. We decided to push some new quality upgrades to the demo too!Among many smaller changes and bug fixes, in the new update you can find:EngineUpgraded to unreal engine 5.8.1HUDImplemented new fontAudioNew soldier voicelinesNew guard voicelinesNew player voicelinesNew bullet whizzing effectEnemiesNew boomer shieldDomi
